ex.en: Where's the checkout counter?
ex.zh: 結帳櫃檯在哪裡？

ex.en: There was a long line at the checkout.
ex.zh: 結帳櫃檯大排長龍。

ex.en: Add items to your cart and proceed to checkout.
ex.zh: 把商品加入購物車，然後前往結帳。

ex.en: Checkout time is 11 a.m.
ex.zh: 退房時間是上午十一點。

ex.en: Can I have a late checkout?
ex.zh: 我可以延後退房嗎？

ex.en: I majored in chemistry at the university.
ex.zh: 我大學主修化學。

ex.en: Which do you like better, physics or chemistry?
ex.zh: 物理和化學，你比較喜歡哪一科？

ex.en: There's great chemistry between the two actors.
ex.zh: 這兩位演員之間很有火花。

ex.en: The team has good chemistry.
ex.zh: 這個團隊默契很好。

ex.en: Mike was elected chairperson.
ex.zh: 麥克當選為主席。

ex.en: We elected her chairperson.
ex.zh: 我們選她為主席。

ex.en: She was appointed chairperson.
ex.zh: 她被任命為主席。

ex.en: She donates to several charitable organizations.
ex.zh: 她捐款給好幾個慈善機構。

ex.en: The company supports many charitable causes.
ex.zh: 這家公司支持許多慈善公益活動。

ex.en: I'd like a cheeseburger and fries, please.
ex.zh: 我要一個起司漢堡和薯條。

ex.en: This place makes the best cheeseburgers in town.
ex.zh: 這家店的起司漢堡是全城最好吃的。

ex.en: My sister is cheering for a young Sumo wrestler.
ex.zh: 我姊姊在幫一位年輕的相撲選手加油。

ex.en: The crowd cheered when the team scored.
ex.zh: 球隊得分時，群眾歡呼起來。

ex.en: The situation is improving, so cheer up!
ex.zh: 情況在好轉，振作起來吧！

ex.en: After hearing the news, she cheered up.
ex.zh: 聽到這個消息後，她開心起來了。

ex.en: The flowers cheered her up.
ex.zh: 那些花讓她心情好了起來。

ex.en: The audience gave a loud cheer.
ex.zh: 觀眾大聲歡呼。

ex.en: Cheers filled the stadium after the final goal.
ex.zh: 最後一球進門後，體育場內充滿了歡呼聲。

ex.en: The German chancellor visited Paris last week.
ex.zh: 德國總理上週訪問了巴黎。

ex.en: The chancellor of the university gave a speech.
ex.zh: 大學校長發表了演說。

ex.en: We chartered a bus for the company trip.
ex.zh: 我們為員工旅遊包了一台遊覽車。

ex.en: The team chartered a plane to the game.
ex.zh: 球隊包機去比賽。

ex.en: The charter sets out the rights of all members.
ex.zh: 憲章載明了所有成員的權利。

ex.en: We took a charter flight to Okinawa.
ex.zh: 我們搭包機去沖繩。

cheque.zh: 支票（英式拼法，美式為 check）

ex.en: I haven't got any cash. Can I write a cheque?
ex.zh: 我沒帶現金，可以開支票嗎？

ex.en: Cheques are made of paper.
ex.zh: 支票是用紙做的。

ex.en: The cheque bounced because his account was empty.
ex.zh: 因為他帳戶沒錢，那張支票跳票了。

ex.en: The accident caused traffic chaos.
ex.zh: 那場車禍造成交通大亂。

ex.en: The world is in chaos.
ex.zh: 世界陷入一片混亂。

ex.en: The office was in chaos after the system crashed.
ex.zh: 系統當機後，辦公室一片混亂。

ex.en: That boy threw a chunk of stone.
ex.zh: 那個男孩丟了一塊石頭。

ex.en: Cut the chicken into small chunks.
ex.zh: 把雞肉切成小塊。

ex.en: Rent takes a big chunk of my salary.
ex.zh: 房租佔了我薪水的一大部分。

ex.en: We spent a large chunk of the budget on marketing.
ex.zh: 我們把一大部分預算花在行銷上。

ex.en: He was caught cheating in the exam.
ex.zh: 他考試作弊被抓到。

ex.en: It is wrong to cheat at cards.
ex.zh: 玩牌作弊是不對的。

ex.en: During the exam, Tom cheated off Mary.
ex.zh: 考試時，湯姆抄了瑪麗的答案。

ex.en: Never did I dream that George would cheat me.
ex.zh: 我做夢也沒想到喬治會騙我。

ex.en: The man cheated the old woman out of her money.
ex.zh: 那個男人騙走了老太太的錢。

ex.en: I found out where to buy fruit cheaply.
ex.zh: 我找到可以便宜買水果的地方了。

ex.en: You can travel cheaply in Southeast Asia.
ex.zh: 在東南亞可以很省錢地旅行。

ex.en: I don't believe the child came to Tokyo alone.
ex.zh: 我不相信那孩子是自己一個人來東京的。

ex.en: I'll look after your child while you are away.
ex.zh: 你不在的時候，我會照顧你的孩子。

ex.en: The doctor is a great authority on children's diseases.
ex.zh: 那位醫生是兒童疾病的權威。

ex.en: If you can't have children, you could always adopt.
ex.zh: 如果你們不能生孩子，還可以領養。

ex.en: They have three children.
ex.zh: 他們有三個孩子。

ex.en: I chose this topic because I think it's interesting.
ex.zh: 我選這個主題是因為我覺得它很有趣。

ex.en: Choose a suitable satellite image as the base map.
ex.zh: 選一張合適的衛星影像當底圖。

ex.en: I had the good fortune to be chosen.
ex.zh: 我很幸運地被選中了。

ex.en: Many people choose to work from home.
ex.zh: 許多人選擇在家工作。

ex.en: She chose not to attend the meeting.
ex.zh: 她決定不出席會議。

ex.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.
ex.zh: 銀行對高風險客戶的貸款收取較高利息。

ex.en: The hotel charges 20 dollars for parking.
ex.zh: 飯店停車收費二十美元。

ex.en: There is no charge for delivery.
ex.zh: 運送不收費。

ex.en: Is there an extra charge for breakfast?
ex.zh: 早餐要另外收費嗎？

ex.en: I'd like a phone that supports fast charging.
ex.zh: 我想要支援快充的手機。

ex.en: I need to charge my phone.
ex.zh: 我需要幫手機充電。

ex.en: Who is in charge of this project?
ex.zh: 這個專案由誰負責？

ex.en: Amy is in charge while the manager is away.
ex.zh: 經理不在時由艾咪負責。

ex.en: He was in prison on a charge of robbery.
ex.zh: 他因搶劫罪入獄。

ex.en: She wishes to press charges.
ex.zh: 她想要提出告訴。

ex.en: I don't think we'd have any chance of winning.
ex.zh: 我覺得我們沒有任何贏的機會。

ex.en: This scandal will likely ruin your chances of being elected.
ex.zh: 這則醜聞很可能會毀了你當選的機會。

ex.en: Thank you for giving me this chance.
ex.zh: 謝謝你給我這個機會。

ex.en: There is little chance of my meeting him again.
ex.zh: 我再見到他的可能性很小。

ex.en: What are the chances we'll have a white Christmas?
ex.zh: 聖誕節下雪的機率有多大？

ex.en: The chances are he's already heard the news.
ex.zh: 他很可能已經聽說這個消息了。

ex.en: I ran into my aunt by chance in Europe.
ex.zh: 我在歐洲偶然碰到我阿姨。

ex.en: We met by chance at the airport.
ex.zh: 我們在機場巧遇。

ex.en: You should be careful in your choice of friends.
ex.zh: 你選擇朋友時要小心。

ex.en: Why is judo the best choice for your child?
ex.zh: 為什麼柔道是你孩子的最佳選擇？

ex.en: Could you tell me what my choices are?
ex.zh: 可以告訴我有哪些選擇嗎？

choice.zh: have no choice but to：不得不、只好

ex.en: There was no choice but to sit and wait.
ex.zh: 只好坐下來等。

ex.en: We had no choice but to cancel the trip.
ex.zh: 我們不得不取消旅行。

ex.en: Check that your username and password are written correctly.
ex.zh: 請檢查使用者名稱和密碼有沒有打錯。

ex.en: Check the tools and see if anything is missing.
ex.zh: 檢查一下工具，看看有沒有少什麼。

ex.en: Two men are checking on what's wrong with the car.
ex.zh: 兩個男人在檢查車子哪裡有問題。

ex.en: Before you can board the plane, you'll have to go through airport security checks.
ex.zh: 登機前你得通過機場安檢。

ex.en: The mechanic did a safety check on the car.
ex.zh: 技師對車子做了安全檢查。

ex.en: Could we have the check, please?
ex.zh: 可以給我們帳單嗎？

ex.en: I paid the rent by check.
ex.zh: 我用支票付房租。

check.zh: check in / out：辦理入住、登機報到／退房

ex.en: We checked in at the hotel at three.
ex.zh: 我們三點在飯店辦理入住。

ex.en: What time do we need to check out?
ex.zh: 我們幾點要退房？

ex.en: He is a man of strong, stable and trustworthy character.
ex.zh: 他是個性格堅強、穩重又可靠的人。

ex.en: Honesty is an important part of his character.
ex.zh: 誠實是他品格中重要的一部分。

ex.en: Who is your favorite character in the movie?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡電影裡的哪個角色？

ex.en: The main character is a young doctor.
ex.zh: 主角是一位年輕醫生。

ex.en: These Chinese characters are not too difficult for us.
ex.zh: 這些漢字對我們來說不太難。

ex.en: Does anyone know how to pronounce this character?
ex.zh: 有人知道這個字怎麼唸嗎？

ex.en: Your password must be at least eight characters long.
ex.zh: 你的密碼至少要八個字元。

ex.en: The old church by the lake is very beautiful.
ex.zh: 湖邊那座老教堂很漂亮。

ex.en: There are two churches in this street.
ex.zh: 這條街上有兩座教堂。

ex.en: The church is at the foot of a mountain.
ex.zh: 教堂位於山腳下。

ex.en: I don't get enough challenge in this job.
ex.zh: 這份工作對我來說挑戰不夠。

ex.en: She said she enjoyed the challenge.
ex.zh: 她說她很享受那個挑戰。

ex.en: I'm captivated by the challenges of translation.
ex.zh: 翻譯的挑戰讓我著迷。

ex.en: Tom likes challenging himself.
ex.zh: 湯姆喜歡挑戰自己。

ex.en: She challenged me to a game of chess.
ex.zh: 她向我挑戰下一盤棋。

ex.en: Nobody dared to challenge the manager's decision.
ex.zh: 沒人敢質疑經理的決定。

ex.en: Several people challenged his claim.
ex.zh: 好幾個人質疑他的說法。

ex.en: How many chairs do you have around your table?
ex.zh: 你家餐桌旁有幾張椅子？

ex.en: Please remove that chair because it is in the way.
ex.zh: 請把那張椅子移開，它擋到路了。

ex.en: Tom carried the chairs to the next room.
ex.zh: 湯姆把椅子搬到隔壁房間。

ex.en: She is the chair of the board.
ex.zh: 她是董事會主席。

ex.en: Please address your questions to the chair.
ex.zh: 請向主席提問。

ex.en: Who will chair the meeting tomorrow?
ex.zh: 明天的會議由誰主持？

ex.en: My manager chaired the committee for two years.
ex.zh: 我的經理擔任委員會主席兩年。

chief.zh: 主要的；首席的、最高階的

ex.en: I got acquainted with the chief executive.
ex.zh: 我認識了那位執行長。

ex.en: The chief reason for the delay was bad weather.
ex.zh: 延誤的主要原因是天候不佳。

ex.en: She was promoted to chief financial officer.
ex.zh: 她被升為財務長。

ex.en: He is the chief of my department.
ex.zh: 他是我們部門的主管。

ex.en: The police chief spoke to reporters.
ex.zh: 警察局長對記者發表談話。

ex.en: Let's begin with the first chapter.
ex.zh: 我們從第一章開始吧。

ex.en: We will deal with this problem in Chapter Three.
ex.zh: 我們會在第三章討論這個問題。

ex.en: This chapter is the heart of the novel.
ex.zh: 這一章是整部小說的核心。

ex.en: She works for a large hotel chain.
ex.zh: 她在一家大型連鎖飯店工作。

ex.en: The coffee chain plans to open 50 new stores.
ex.zh: 這家連鎖咖啡店計畫開五十家新店。

ex.en: She wore a gold chain around her neck.
ex.zh: 她脖子上戴著一條金項鍊。

ex.en: The chain came off my bike again.
ex.zh: 我的腳踏車又掉鏈了。

ex.en: We want to develop a new supply chain with a supplier from Algeria.
ex.zh: 我們想和一家阿爾及利亞的供應商建立新的供應鏈。

ex.en: A chain of events led to the accident.
ex.zh: 一連串的事件導致了這場意外。

ex.en: What is on Channel 10?
ex.zh: 第十台在播什麼節目？

ex.en: Start your own YouTube channel.
ex.zh: 開設你自己的 YouTube 頻道吧。

ex.en: You can just switch channels.
ex.zh: 你轉台就好了啊。

ex.en: Please send all requests through the proper channels.
ex.zh: 所有申請請透過正式管道提出。

ex.en: Social media is an important sales channel.
ex.zh: 社群媒體是重要的銷售管道。

channel.zh: 把（精力、資金）投入、引導到

ex.en: She channeled her energy into her work.
ex.zh: 她把精力投入到工作上。

ex.en: We should channel more money into research.
ex.zh: 我們應該把更多資金投入研究。

ex.en: The weather here has its own unique characteristics.
ex.zh: 這裡的天氣有獨特的特色。

ex.en: Pigs share certain characteristics with human beings.
ex.zh: 豬和人類有某些共同的特徵。

ex.en: What are the characteristics of this new type of urban life?
ex.zh: 這種新型都市生活有什麼特色？

ex.en: The aurora is a phenomenon characteristic of the polar regions.
ex.zh: 極光是極地特有的現象。

ex.en: I got over the difficulty with my characteristic tenacity.
ex.zh: 我憑著一貫的堅持克服了困難。

ex.en: This trash bag does not contain any dangerous chemicals.
ex.zh: 這個垃圾袋不含任何有害化學物質。

ex.en: Wear gloves when handling chemicals.
ex.zh: 處理化學藥品時要戴手套。

ex.en: Heating water does not change its chemical composition.
ex.zh: 把水加熱不會改變它的化學成分。

ex.en: Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
ex.zh: 化學工廠一著火就爆炸了。

ex.en: She was elected chairman of the committee.
ex.zh: 她當選為委員會主席。

ex.en: He's the chairman of the committee.
ex.zh: 他是委員會主席。

ex.en: The chairman of the board will speak at the meeting.
ex.zh: 董事長將在會議上致詞。

ex.en: This photo takes me back to my childhood.
ex.zh: 這張照片讓我回到了童年。

ex.en: That song always reminds me of my childhood.
ex.zh: 那首歌總讓我想起童年。

ex.en: From childhood I dreamed of being a pastry cook.
ex.zh: 我從小就夢想成為糕點師。

ex.en: Taiwan is famous for making computer chips.
ex.zh: 台灣以生產電腦晶片聞名。

ex.en: The new phone uses a faster chip.
ex.zh: 新手機使用了更快的晶片。

ex.en: I shouldn't have eaten the whole bag of potato chips.
ex.zh: 我不該把一整包洋芋片吃完的。

ex.en: There was a single potato chip on each plate.
ex.zh: 每個盤子上都有一片洋芋片。

ex.en: The chip in Yanni's windshield became a huge crack.
ex.zh: 雅尼擋風玻璃上的小缺口變成了一道大裂縫。

ex.en: There's a chip in this cup.
ex.zh: 這個杯子有個缺口。

ex.en: We all chipped in to buy Tom a birthday present.
ex.zh: 我們大家湊錢買了一份生日禮物給湯姆。

ex.en: Everyone chipped in to help clean the office.
ex.zh: 大家都出了一份力幫忙打掃辦公室。

ex.en: How would you characterize your management style?
ex.zh: 你會怎麼形容你的管理風格？

ex.en: The report characterizes the market as stable.
ex.zh: 這份報告將市場形容為穩定。

ex.en: The region is characterized by hot summers.
ex.zh: 這個地區的特色是夏天炎熱。

ex.en: His work is characterized by attention to detail.
ex.zh: 他的工作特色是注重細節。

ex.en: We have two dogs, three cats, and six chickens.
ex.zh: 我們養了兩隻狗、三隻貓和六隻雞。

ex.en: A chicken hatches an egg and a chick emerges.
ex.zh: 母雞孵蛋，孵出小雞。

ex.en: I'll have the grilled chicken, please.
ex.zh: 我要烤雞，謝謝。

ex.en: Chicken is cheaper than beef.
ex.zh: 雞肉比牛肉便宜。

ex.en: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.
ex.zh: 湯姆把一半的薪水捐給他最喜歡的慈善機構。

ex.en: Whenever I get a large sum of money, I donate some of it to charity.
ex.zh: 每當我拿到一大筆錢，就會捐一部分給慈善機構。

ex.en: Tom regularly donates money to charity.
ex.zh: 湯姆經常捐錢給慈善機構。

ex.en: Local businesses are teaming up for a charity initiative.
ex.zh: 當地企業正在聯手推動一項慈善活動。

ex.en: It is justice, not charity, that is wanting in the world.
ex.zh: 這世界缺少的是公義，而不是施捨。

ex.en: The old cottage has a certain charm about it.
ex.zh: 這間老農舍有它獨特的魅力。

ex.en: He had a certain charm.
ex.zh: 他有一種魅力。

ex.en: Her charm is beyond description.
ex.zh: 她的魅力難以言喻。

ex.en: The singer charmed the audience with her voice.
ex.zh: 那位歌手用歌聲迷住了觀眾。

ex.en: He charmed everyone at the party.
ex.zh: 他在派對上讓每個人都對他很有好感。

ex.en: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
ex.zh: 大家都很想知道前冠軍後來怎麼了。

ex.en: There can only be one world champion. The question is: Who will it be?
ex.zh: 世界冠軍只能有一個。問題是：會是誰呢？

ex.en: The mayor championed the new park project.
ex.zh: 市長大力支持新公園計畫。

ex.en: She champions equal pay for women.
ex.zh: 她倡導女性同酬。

ex.en: I have a pain in my chest.
ex.zh: 我胸口痛。

ex.en: He felt a tightness in his chest.
ex.zh: 他覺得胸口很悶。

ex.en: Tom utilized some wooden chests as chairs.
ex.zh: 湯姆把幾個木箱當椅子用。

ex.en: This chest has old clothes in it.
ex.zh: 這個箱子裡有一些舊衣服。

chest.zh: get … off one's chest：把心事說出來

ex.en: I just need to get something off my chest.
ex.zh: 我只是想把心裡的話說出來。

ex.en: You'll feel better if you get it off your chest.
ex.zh: 把心事說出來你會覺得好過一點。

ex.en: In the most secret chamber of the castle lay the greatest treasure on earth—the Book of Truth.
ex.zh: 城堡最隱密的房間裡，藏著世上最珍貴的寶物——《真理之書》。

ex.en: The meeting was held in the council chamber.
ex.zh: 會議在議事廳舉行。

ex.en: She is a member of the local chamber of commerce.
ex.zh: 她是當地商會的會員。

ex.en: The Chamber of Commerce organized a business fair.
ex.zh: 商會舉辦了一場商展。

ex.en: In my sandwich there is meat, cheese and tomatoes.
ex.zh: 我的三明治裡有肉、起司和番茄。

ex.en: Don't you know cheese is made from milk?
ex.zh: 你不知道起司是用牛奶做的嗎？

ex.en: The store sells foodstuffs, such as butter, cheese, and sugar.
ex.zh: 這家店賣奶油、起司和砂糖之類的食品。

ex.en: Life is like a box of chocolates.
ex.zh: 人生就像一盒巧克力。

ex.en: The more chocolate you eat, the fatter you'll get.
ex.zh: 你吃越多巧克力就會越胖。

ex.en: He ate a box of chocolates.
ex.zh: 他吃了一盒巧克力。

ex.en: I competed with him for the championship.
ex.zh: 我和他爭奪冠軍。

ex.en: After many years of grueling training, she finally made a breakthrough and won the championship.
ex.zh: 經過多年的艱苦訓練，她終於突破自我，贏得冠軍。

ex.en: The world championship will be held in Tokyo.
ex.zh: 世界錦標賽將在東京舉行。

ex.en: The cat chased the mouse around the house.
ex.zh: 貓在屋子裡追著老鼠跑。

ex.en: The dog chased the rabbit.
ex.zh: 狗在追兔子。

ex.en: She moved to Taipei to chase her dreams.
ex.zh: 她搬到台北追求夢想。

ex.en: Don't chase every new trend.
ex.zh: 不要盲目追逐每個新潮流。

ex.en: The movie ends with an exciting car chase.
ex.zh: 電影以一場刺激的飛車追逐結尾。

ex.en: After a long chase, the police caught the thief.
ex.zh: 經過一番追捕，警察抓到了小偷。

ex.en: He gave her a peck on the cheek.
ex.zh: 他在她臉頰上輕輕親了一下。

ex.en: Tom gave Mary a kiss on both cheeks.
ex.zh: 湯姆親了瑪麗的兩頰。

ex.en: Tom has a scar on his cheek.
ex.zh: 湯姆的臉頰上有一道疤。

ex.en: The novel has excellent characterization.
ex.zh: 這部小說的人物塑造很出色。

ex.en: Good characterization makes a story believable.
ex.zh: 好的人物塑造讓故事更可信。

ex.en: I don't agree with his characterization of the problem.
ex.zh: 我不同意他對這個問題的描述。

ex.en: Her characterization of the meeting was accurate.
ex.zh: 她對會議的描述很準確。

ex.en: Many cancer patients lose their hair because of the chemotherapy.
ex.zh: 很多癌症病人因為化療而掉髮。

ex.en: She is undergoing chemotherapy for breast cancer.
ex.zh: 她正在接受乳癌的化療。

ex.en: If you like, I will teach you to play chess.
ex.zh: 你想學的話，我可以教你下西洋棋。

ex.en: You're a better chess player than I am.
ex.zh: 你西洋棋下得比我好。

ex.en: He carried off the first prize at the chess tournament.
ex.zh: 他在西洋棋比賽中拿下了冠軍。

ex.en: Sodium chloride is the chemical name for table salt.
ex.zh: 氯化鈉是食鹽的化學名稱。

ex.en: The water was tested for chloride levels.
ex.zh: 這些水做了氯化物含量檢測。

ex.en: Dogs have 39 pairs of chromosomes.
ex.zh: 狗有 39 對染色體。

ex.en: Each chromosome carries thousands of genes.
ex.zh: 每條染色體都帶有數千個基因。

ex.en: The chairwoman opened the meeting at nine o'clock.
ex.zh: 女主席在九點宣布會議開始。

ex.en: She was elected chairwoman of the board last year.
ex.zh: 她去年獲選為董事長。

check-in.zh: （機場、飯店的）報到、登記入住手續

ex.en: Where is the United Airlines check-in counter?
ex.zh: 聯合航空的報到櫃檯在哪裡？

ex.en: Hotel check-in begins at 3 p.m.
ex.zh: 飯店入住登記從下午三點開始。

ex.en: Online check-in opens 24 hours before the flight.
ex.zh: 線上報到在起飛前 24 小時開放。

check-in.zh: （與主管、同事的）簡短進度確認

ex.en: Let's have a quick check-in every Monday morning.
ex.zh: 我們每週一早上簡短確認一下進度吧。

ex.en: My manager scheduled a weekly check-in with me.
ex.zh: 我的主管安排每週跟我做一次進度確認。

ex.en: We sang, danced and chatted after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐後我們唱歌、跳舞、聊天。

ex.en: Just now I was chatting with my parents.
ex.zh: 剛才我在和我爸媽閒聊。

ex.en: Bob is very timid and blushes when chatting with girls.
ex.zh: 鮑伯非常膽小，和女生聊天時會臉紅。

ex.en: Tom, I want to have a chat with you.
ex.zh: 湯姆，我想跟你聊聊。

ex.en: Nancy is having a chat with her friends.
ex.zh: 南西正在跟朋友聊天。

ex.en: Do you have a room that's a little cheaper?
ex.zh: 你們有沒有比較便宜的房間？

ex.en: Would you know a cheap hotel in the near?
ex.zh: 您知道附近有便宜的旅館嗎？

ex.en: If I buy more, can I get them cheaper?
ex.zh: 我多買一些，可以便宜點嗎？

cheap.zh: 廉價的、品質差的；小氣的

ex.en: The bag looks cheap and won't last long.
ex.zh: 這個包看起來很廉價，用不久。

ex.en: Don't be so cheap. Leave a tip.
ex.zh: 別那麼小氣，給點小費吧。

ex.en: Here's your change. Have a nice day.
ex.zh: 這是找您的錢，祝您有美好的一天。

ex.en: Do you have change for a hundred?
ex.zh: 你有一百元的零錢可以換嗎？

ex.en: No matter what happens, I won't change my mind.
ex.zh: 不管發生什麼事，我都不會改變主意。

ex.en: The room looks different after I've changed the curtains.
ex.zh: 我換了窗簾之後，房間看起來不一樣了。

ex.en: In ten years our town will change a lot.
ex.zh: 十年後，我們的城市會改變很多。

ex.en: Science has brought about many changes to our lives.
ex.zh: 科學為我們的生活帶來了許多的改變。

ex.en: We have experienced many changes over the last decade.
ex.zh: 過去十年我們經歷了很多變化。

ex.en: She suffers from chronic back pain.
ex.zh: 她有慢性背痛。

ex.en: The city has a chronic shortage of housing.
ex.zh: 這座城市長期住房不足。

ex.en: The doctor was giving a patient a checkup.
ex.zh: 醫生正在幫一位病人做健康檢查。

ex.en: You should get a checkup once a year.
ex.zh: 你應該每年做一次健康檢查。

ex.en: It's a little chilly in here.
ex.zh: 這裡有點冷。

ex.en: It's a chilly morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上冷颼颼的。

ex.en: More and more married couples share household chores.
ex.zh: 越來越多夫妻一起分擔家事。

ex.en: My kids help with chores like washing dishes.
ex.zh: 我的孩子會幫忙洗碗之類的家事。

ex.en: Tom is a famous chef.
ex.zh: 湯姆是有名的廚師。

ex.en: We have a very good chef.
ex.zh: 我們有一位非常好的廚師。

ex.en: She used to be a part time chef, then she became full time.
ex.zh: 她以前是兼職廚師，後來做了全職。

ex.en: Tom is a chauffeur.
ex.zh: 湯姆是專職司機。

ex.en: Her chauffeur waited outside the hotel until the meeting ended.
ex.zh: 會議結束前，她的司機一直在飯店外等候。

ex.en: My cholesterol is high.
ex.zh: 我的膽固醇偏高。

ex.en: The nutrition label lists the amount of cholesterol per serving.
ex.zh: 營養標示列出每份所含的膽固醇量。

ex.en: Sue checked in at the Royal Hotel.
ex.zh: 蘇在皇家飯店辦理了入住。

ex.en: He checked in at a good hotel.
ex.zh: 他入住了一間很好的旅館。

ex.en: Can I leave my bags with you until I come to check in?
ex.zh: 在我辦理入住之前，可以先把行李寄放在你這裡嗎？

ex.en: You should check in at least two hours before an international flight.
ex.zh: 搭國際航班至少要提前兩小時辦理報到。

ex.en: We checked in online, so we only had to drop off our bags.
ex.zh: 我們已經線上報到，所以只需要托運行李。

ex.en: I'm going to check out at eight.
ex.zh: 我會在八點退房。

ex.en: I'd like to check out right now.
ex.zh: 我想現在退房。

ex.en: Recently someone told me about a language website, tatoeba.org, which I will definitely check out.
ex.zh: 最近有人告訴我一個語言網站，tatoeba.org。我一定要看看。

ex.en: You should check out the new café near the station.
ex.zh: 你應該去看看車站附近那家新咖啡店。

ex.en: If you're worried, go for an endoscopy to have it checked out.
ex.zh: 要是不放心的話，你去做個胃鏡查一查。

ex.en: Get your car checked out before the long trip.
ex.zh: 長途旅行前把車子送去檢查一下。

ex.en: The workflow is illustrated in the following chart.
ex.zh: 工作流程如下圖所示。

ex.en: This chart shows our sales over the past year.
ex.zh: 這張圖表顯示我們過去一年的銷售狀況。

ex.en: Her new song is at the top of the charts.
ex.zh: 她的新歌登上排行榜冠軍。

ex.en: The album stayed on the charts for months.
ex.zh: 這張專輯在排行榜上待了好幾個月。
